sections.heading: Custody and examination
sections.text: CB-3 and YK-3 were photographed after recovery. Keeper fasteners remain installed and the plate remains attached. The full plate and fasteners show no gross separation or fracture. This inspection does not establish dynamic overlap during release.

sections.heading: Condition
sections.text: Witness marks are present on the carrier and mill post/spreader contact surfaces. The marks are consistent with contact but cannot alone date when contact began or establish the exact load carried.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: No material record supports a fatigue-fracture explanation of a keeper bolt in this examination. Unmeasured deformation and the off-center release path remain separate questions.
